verdict.rationale: Docs describe crypto payments settling as fiat in the merchant's Stripe balance and stablecoin payouts to connected accounts/financial accounts, but there is no documented dedicated 'off-ramp' feature converting stablecoin balances into bank transfers with a published list of supported currencies/countries — in fact docs note stablecoin balances exist precisely in markets where fiat Treasury isn't available, implying no guaranteed bank conversion there. Missing for 10: explicit off-ramp/conversion mechanism from stablecoin to bank transfer, a published country/currency coverage list, and independent confirmation it works as described.
